_comment: Khatian (ownership) records per BDS dag number, keyed by ASCII dag number as shown on the official settlement.gov.bd khatian viewer. Each entry lists one or more khatians: 'no' is the khatian number, 'owners' are the recorded owner names, and 'status' is the current share column (চলমান জর) exactly as printed on the portal. Dags without an entry show the 'verify on the settlement portal' note in the popup.
